query: I have an 83-year-old female inpatient. Among female patients aged 78–88 with acute ischemic stroke, what was the minimum 72-hour laboratory instability score? Also compare cohort average critical lab events to general inpatients and report cohort LOS and in-hospital mortality.
final_sql:
WITH Cohort AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.deathtime,
    a.hospital_expire_flag,
    a.hadm_id,
    d.icd_code,
    d.seq_num
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS p
  JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS a
    ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
  JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS d
    ON;
